# Kartikey Gupta — Senior Full-Stack Developer & GenAI Engineer

## Who I Am

Kartikey Gupta is a Senior Full-Stack Developer and GenAI Engineer based in India, with 7 years of experience shipping production AI-first systems across Fortune-500 fintech (FIS Global / Worldpay), SaaS startups, and product companies. Available for remote senior and lead engineering roles worldwide.

## Services & What I Build

- **Full-Stack Web Development** — Node.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python. End-to-end: database schema to production deployment.
- **AI & GenAI Integration** — LLM pipelines (Groq Llama 3.3, Claude, Ollama), RAG pipelines, MCP agents, agentic workflows, streaming completions, function calling.
- **Backend Engineering** — REST APIs, GraphQL, microservices, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, message queues, system design.
- **React Native Mobile Development** — Cross-platform iOS & Android from a shared codebase.
- **ETL & Data Pipelines** — SSIS, bidirectional sync, Salesforce API, fault-tolerant pipelines with dead-letter queuing and audit trails.
- **Technical Leadership** — Architecture design, code reviews, engineering roadmaps, team mentorship (led 3–4 engineer teams).
- **DevOps** — AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), Docker, CI/CD, Nginx.

## Key Achievements (with real numbers)

- Built AI support platform on Groq Llama 3.3 — **72% of tier-1 tickets auto-resolved** without human intervention at 99.7% uptime
- Designed MCP server with agentic workflows — **6h+/week of manual ops eliminated**, full immutable audit trail
- Led Python → Node.js backend migration — **−30% API latency**, **+40% portal adoption**, zero downtime
- Built Selenium CRM regression framework — **90%+ workflow coverage**, −80% manual QA, <8 min full CI runtime
- Delivered fault-tolerant MongoDB↔Salesforce ETL via SSIS — **95% data accuracy**, zero manual reconciliation
- Led 3-engineer team shipping healthcare monitoring platform (web + mobile + custom smartwatch) — **+25% performance**, −35% bugs
